GOOD QUESTIONS. CLEAR ANSWERS.

Frequently asked questions

Which operating systems are available for use?

We provide a wide selection of operating systems to choose from, including Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian, and many more.

Will I have root access to my VPS?

Yes, every VPS comes with root access to the server, along with SSH and SFTP/FTP support for easy management.

What technical expertise is needed for Unmanaged VPS hosting?

Unmanaged VPS hosting is ideal for users with advanced technical skills, including experience in server management, software installations, and troubleshooting.

Do we offer any support for Unmanaged VPS hosting?

Unmanaged VPS hosting does not come with direct support from ServerAnywhere. However, you can use google to access detailed documentation and knowledge base for guidance and troubleshooting.

Is backup included with Unmanaged VPS hosting?

Backups for Unmanaged VPS hosting are your responsibility. We do not offer any backup services.
